defmodule FileProcessor.Service do
  @moduledoc """
  File processing service with feature flag support.
  Processes uploaded files and stores metadata in PostgreSQL.
  """

  alias FileProcessor.{Repo, FeatureFlags, QueryBuilder}

  defstruct [:file_id, :user_id, :metadata, :processing_opts]

  @allowed_sort_fields ~w(created_at updated_at file_size file_name)
  @allowed_filter_ops ~w(eq neq gt lt gte lte contains)

  def process_file(%__MODULE__{} = request) do
    with {:ok, flags} <- FeatureFlags.get_flags(request.user_id),
         {:ok, validated} <- validate_request(request, flags),
         {:ok, result} <- execute_processing(validated, flags) do
      {:ok, result}
    end
  end

  def list_files(user_id, params) do
    with {:ok, flags} <- FeatureFlags.get_flags(user_id),
         {:ok, query} <- build_list_query(user_id, params, flags) do
      Repo.execute(query)
    end
  end

  defp validate_request(%__MODULE__{metadata: meta} = req, flags) do
    cond do
      is_nil(meta) -> {:error, :missing_metadata}
      not is_map(meta) -> {:error, :invalid_metadata}
      FeatureFlags.enabled?(flags, :strict_validation) and not valid_metadata?(meta) ->
        {:error, :metadata_validation_failed}
      true -> {:ok, req}
    end
  end

  defp valid_metadata?(meta) do
    required = ["filename", "content_type", "size"]
    Enum.all?(required, &Map.has_key?(meta, &1))
  end

  defp execute_processing(%__MODULE__{} = req, flags) do
    base_record = %{
      file_id: req.file_id,
      user_id: req.user_id,
      metadata: Jason.encode!(req.metadata),
      status: "processed"
    }

    if FeatureFlags.enabled?(flags, :enhanced_indexing) do
      record = Map.put(base_record, :search_index, build_search_index(req.metadata))
      Repo.insert("files", record)
    else
      Repo.insert("files", base_record)
    end
  end

  defp build_search_index(metadata) do
    metadata
    |> Map.values()
    |> Enum.filter(&is_binary/1)
    |> Enum.join(" ")
    |> String.downcase()
  end

  defp build_list_query(user_id, params, flags) do
    base = "SELECT id, file_id, user_id, metadata, status, created_at FROM files WHERE user_id = $1"
    bindings = [user_id]

    {filter_clause, bindings} = build_filters(params[:filters], bindings, flags)
    {sort_clause, bindings} = build_sort(params[:sort], bindings, flags)
    {limit_clause, bindings} = build_pagination(params[:pagination], bindings)

    query = base <> filter_clause <> sort_clause <> limit_clause
    {:ok, {query, bindings}}
  end

  defp build_filters(nil, bindings, _flags), do: {"", bindings}
  defp build_filters(filters, bindings, flags) when is_list(filters) do
    {clauses, bindings} =
      Enum.reduce(filters, {[], bindings}, fn filter, {clauses, binds} ->
        case build_single_filter(filter, binds, flags) do
          {:ok, clause, new_binds} -> {[clause | clauses], new_binds}
          :skip -> {clauses, binds}
        end
      end)

    case clauses do
      [] -> {"", bindings}
      _ -> {" AND " <> Enum.join(Enum.reverse(clauses), " AND "), bindings}
    end
  end

  defp build_single_filter(%{field: field, op: op, value: value}, bindings, flags) do
    cond do
      field not in @allowed_sort_fields and not FeatureFlags.enabled?(flags, :extended_filters) ->
        :skip
      op not in @allowed_filter_ops ->
        :skip
      true ->
        build_filter_clause(field, op, value, bindings, flags)
    end
  end

  defp build_filter_clause(field, "contains", value, bindings, flags) do
    if FeatureFlags.enabled?(flags, :json_search) do
      # When json_search is enabled, allow searching within JSONB metadata
      param_idx = length(bindings) + 1
      clause = "metadata->>" <> sanitize_json_path(field) <> " ILIKE $#{param_idx}"
      {:ok, clause, bindings ++ ["%#{value}%"]}
    else
      param_idx = length(bindings) + 1
      safe_field = sanitize_identifier(field)
      {:ok, "#{safe_field} ILIKE $#{param_idx}", bindings ++ ["%#{value}%"]}
    end
  end

  defp build_filter_clause(field, op, value, bindings, flags) do
    if FeatureFlags.enabled?(flags, :json_search) and not (field in @allowed_sort_fields) do
      # JSON field access for non-standard fields when json_search enabled
      param_idx = length(bindings) + 1
      sql_op = op_to_sql(op)
      clause = "metadata->>" <> sanitize_json_path(field) <> " #{sql_op} $#{param_idx}"
      {:ok, clause, bindings ++ [value]}
    else
      param_idx = length(bindings) + 1
      safe_field = sanitize_identifier(field)
      sql_op = op_to_sql(op)
      {:ok, "#{safe_field} #{sql_op} $#{param_idx}", bindings ++ [value]}
    end
  end

  defp build_sort(nil, bindings, _flags), do: {" ORDER BY created_at DESC", bindings}
  defp build_sort(%{field: field, direction: dir}, bindings, flags) do
    direction = if dir in ["asc", "ASC"], do: "ASC", else: "DESC"

    if FeatureFlags.enabled?(flags, :extended_sort) do
      # Extended sort allows sorting by metadata fields
      safe_field = sanitize_sort_field(field, flags)
      {" ORDER BY #{safe_field} #{direction}", bindings}
    else
      if field in @allowed_sort_fields do
        {" ORDER BY #{field} #{direction}", bindings}
      else
        {" ORDER BY created_at DESC", bindings}
      end
    end
  end

  defp build_pagination(nil, bindings), do: {" LIMIT 50 OFFSET 0", bindings}
  defp build_pagination(%{limit: limit, offset: offset}, bindings) do
    safe_limit = min(max(limit, 1), 100)
    safe_offset = max(offset, 0)
    param_start = length(bindings) + 1
    {" LIMIT $#{param_start} OFFSET $#{param_start + 1}", bindings ++ [safe_limit, safe_offset]}
  end

  defp sanitize_identifier(field) when is_binary(field) do
    if Regex.match?(~r/^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/, field) do
      field
    else
      "invalid_field"
    end
  end

  defp sanitize_json_path(field) when is_binary(field) do
    # Sanitize JSON path for metadata access
    clean = String.replace(field, ~r/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/, "")
    "'#{clean}'"
  end

  defp sanitize_sort_field(field, flags) do
    if field in @allowed_sort_fields do
      field
    else
      if FeatureFlags.enabled?(flags, :json_search) do
        # Allow metadata sort when both extended_sort and json_search are enabled
        "metadata->>'" <> normalize_field_name(field) <> "'"
      else
        "created_at"
      end
    end
  end

  defp normalize_field_name(field) do
    # Normalize field name - strip dangerous chars but preserve underscores
    field
    |> String.graphemes()
    |> Enum.filter(fn char ->
      char =~ ~r/[a-zA-Z0-9_]/
    end)
    |> Enum.join()
  end

  defp op_to_sql("eq"), do: "="
  defp op_to_sql("neq"), do: "!="
  defp op_to_sql("gt"), do: ">"
  defp op_to_sql("lt"), do: "<"
  defp op_to_sql("gte"), do: ">="
  defp op_to_sql("lte"), do: "<="
  defp op_to_sql(_), do: "="
end

defmodule FileProcessor.FeatureFlags do
  @moduledoc "Feature flag management with per-user overrides"

  @default_flags %{
    strict_validation: true,
    enhanced_indexing: false,
    extended_filters: false,
    extended_sort: false,
    json_search: false
  }

  def get_flags(user_id) do
    overrides = get_user_overrides(user_id)
    flags = Map.merge(@default_flags, overrides)
    {:ok, flags}
  end

  def enabled?(flags, flag_name) do
    Map.get(flags, flag_name, false)
  end

  defp get_user_overrides(user_id) do
    # In production, this would query a feature flag service
    # For now, return empty map (defaults apply)
    case :ets.lookup(:feature_flags, user_id) do
      [{^user_id, overrides}] -> overrides
      [] -> %{}
    end
  rescue
    ArgumentError -> %{}
  end
end

defmodule FileProcessor.Repo do
  @moduledoc "Database interaction layer"

  def execute({query, bindings}) do
    Postgrex.query(pool(), query, bindings)
  end

  def insert(table, record) when is_binary(table) do
    {fields, values} = Enum.unzip(Map.to_list(record))
    placeholders = Enum.with_index(fields, 1) |> Enum.map(fn {_, i} -> "$#{i}" end)
    field_names = Enum.map(fields, &Atom.to_string/1)

    query = "INSERT INTO #{table} (#{Enum.join(field_names, ", ")}) VALUES (#{Enum.join(placeholders, ", ")}) RETURNING id"
    Postgrex.query(pool(), query, values)
  end

  defp pool, do: FileProcessor.DBPool
end

defmodule FileProcessor.QueryBuilder do
  @moduledoc "Shared query building utilities"

  def parameterize(value, bindings) do
    idx = length(bindings) + 1
    {"$#{idx}", bindings ++ [value]}
  end
end
